items.q: A circle is cut into 4 equal parts. How many quarters make 1 whole circle?
items.hint: Each of the 4 equal parts is a quarter.
steps: The circle has 4 equal parts.
Each part is a quarter.
So 4 quarters make 1 whole circle.

slips.say: Count all the equal parts of the whole circle.

items.q: A paper circle is folded so the edges meet. The fold makes 2 parts that match. What is each part called?
items.hint: 2 equal parts: what do we call each one?
steps: The fold makes 2 parts that match, so they are equal.
One of 2 equal parts is a half.

slips.say: A quarter is one of 4 equal parts. This fold makes 2.
A whole is the shape with no fold.

items.hint: It is half of a circle. It has 1 straight side.
steps: The shape is half of a circle.
It is a half circle.

slips.say: A quarter circle has a corner. This shape has 1 straight side.

items.hint: It is a quarter of a circle. It has a corner.
steps: The shape is a quarter of a circle.
It has a corner where 2 straight sides meet.
It is a quarter circle.

slips.say: A half circle has 1 straight side. This shape has 2 and a corner.

items.q: A rectangle has 8 small squares. A half of it is how many small squares?
items.hint: Share the small squares into 2 groups that match.
steps: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts.
Share 8 small squares into 2 equal groups: 4 and 4.
A half is 4 small squares.

slips.say: Share the squares into 2 groups that match. How many in one group?

tpl.q: A rectangle has {n} small squares. A half of it is how many small squares?
tpl.hint: Share the small squares into 2 groups that match.
steps: A half is 1 of 2 equal parts.
Share {n} small squares into 2 equal groups.
A half is {ans} small squares.

items.q: A rectangle has 12 small squares. A quarter of it is how many small squares?
items.hint: Share the small squares into 4 groups that match.
steps: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts.
Share 12 small squares into 4 equal groups: 3 each.
A quarter is 3 small squares.

slips.say: Share the squares into 4 groups that match. How many in one group?

tpl.q: A rectangle has {n} small squares. A quarter of it is how many small squares?
tpl.hint: Share the small squares into 4 groups that match.
steps: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts.
Share {n} small squares into 4 equal groups.
A quarter is {ans} small squares.

items.q: True or False: any 2 parts of a shape are halves.
items.hint: Halves must be equal. Think about a crooked fold.
steps: Halves are 2 equal parts.
A crooked fold makes 2 parts that do not match.
So the statement is False.

slips.say: Fold a circle crookedly. Do the 2 parts match?

items.q: A paper is folded in half 3 times. How many equal parts are there when it is opened?
items.hint: Each fold cuts every part into 2. The parts double each time.
steps: 1 fold makes 2 parts.
A 2nd fold doubles it: 4 parts.
A 3rd fold doubles it again: 8 parts.

slips.say: Each fold doubles the number of parts. Start with 2 and double.

tpl.q: A paper is folded in half {k} times. How many equal parts are there when it is opened?
tpl.hint: Each fold cuts every part into 2. The parts double each time.
steps: 1 fold makes 2 parts.
Each new fold doubles the parts.
After {k} times there are {p} equal parts.

items.q: A big square has 16 small squares. A quarter of the big square is cut off. How many small squares are left?
items.hint: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts. Find a quarter, then take it away.
steps: A quarter of 16 small squares is 4 small squares.
16 take away 4 is 12.
12 small squares are left.

slips.say: 4 is the quarter that was cut off. How many are left?

tpl.q: A big square has {n} small squares. A quarter of the big square is cut off. How many small squares are left?
tpl.hint: A quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts. Find a quarter, then take it away.
steps: A quarter of {n} small squares is {q} small squares.
{n} take away {q} is {ans}.
{ans} small squares are left.

items.q: A strip of 3 small squares is a quarter of a rectangle. How many small squares are in the whole rectangle?
items.hint: 4 quarters make the whole. The strip is 1 quarter.
steps: The strip is 1 quarter.
4 quarters make the whole.
3, 6, 9, 12: the whole has 12 small squares.

slips.say: 4 quarters make the whole. Count 4 groups of the strip.

tpl.q: A strip of {q} small squares is a quarter of a rectangle. How many small squares are in the whole rectangle?
tpl.hint: 4 quarters make the whole. The strip is 1 quarter.
steps: The strip is 1 quarter.
4 quarters make the whole.
The whole has {ans} small squares.

items.q: A rectangle of 8 small squares is cut into 2 halves. Each half has 4 small squares. Must the 2 halves have the same shape?
items.hint: Think of a long bar of 4 squares and a block of 4 squares.
steps: A long bar of 4 squares and a block of 4 squares are both 4 squares.
They do not have the same shape.
Equal parts do not always have the same shape.

slips.say: Try a bar of 4 squares and a 2 by 2 block. Are they the same shape?

items.q: Fold a paper square into 4 equal parts in two different ways. Draw both ways. Check each by laying the parts on top of each other.
items.hint: Try lines down and across. Then try corner to corner.
steps: Fold the square in half, and in half again.
Draw the fold lines.
Lay the parts on top of each other to check they match.
Fold a new square a different way.

items.hint: One hand names the hour and the other counts the minutes.
steps: The short hand names the hour.
The long hand counts the minutes.

slips.say: The long hand counts the minutes. The short hand names the hour.

items.q: Ben gets up at 6 o'clock. Mei gets up at half past 6. Who gets up first?
steps: 6 o'clock is 6:00.
Half past 6 is 6:30, which is later.
Ben gets up first.

slips.say: 6:30 is later than 6:00. Who has the earlier time?
